list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, server_id AS __value FROM config.config_monitored_servers WHERE is_enabled ORDER BY name
list.description: Monitored SQL Server instance, from Darling's fleet registry.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    qs.bucket AS time,
    qs.server_name AS metric,
    SUM(qs.worker_time_sum) / 1000.0 AS cpu_ms
FROM collect.query_stats_daily AS qs
WHERE $__timeFilter(qs.bucket)
  AND qs.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY qs.bucket, qs.server_name
) AS daily_tier WHERE (CASE WHEN $__timeFrom() >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 'raw' WHEN $__timeFrom() < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days' AND $__timeFrom() >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' ELSE 'hourly' END WHEN $__timeFrom() < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'daily' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) AND (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) AND (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' ELSE 'daily' END END) = 'daily'
UNION ALL

ORDER BY 1
